audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text leans on 'track Scrap Shield' as the matchup-defining cooldown. Scrap Shield is a 6s shield (Riot text: shield plus a burst of move speed) — it is never a window. The real gate is Flamespitter's 10/9/8/7/6s cone and Rumble's heat bar.
audit.why: Kit file: W cd 6, Q cd 10/9/8/7/6, R cd 130/105/80. Passive: at 100% Heat Rumble Overheats and is unable to cast spells.
audit.corrected: Re-key the difficulty and cooldown advice to Flamespitter's 10s at rank 1 and to the Overheat lockout, not to a 6s shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicted itself against the packet chart and against its own whys[]: whys[4] says level 6 Equalizer is his, whys[5] says first item is even, whys[6] says you take over at two items — but win[]/phases[] read Skill, Rumble, Rumble.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Rumble, Rumble, Skill, Rumble, Skill, Wukong]; the prose in whys[4..6], spikes[3] and late all agree with the packet, not with the stored sides.
audit.corrected: Flip rows 4, 5 and 6 in both layers as one atomic group: Rumble / Skill / Wukong. Spikes named with real cooldowns — Equalizer 130s at rank 1, Black Cleaver plus Mercury's as your item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slot labels were wrong (Scrap Shield called '(E)'), Electro Harpoon's two-charge behaviour was never stated, and no Rumble cooldown number appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Kit: W = Scrap Shield, E = Electro Harpoon (850 range, Rumble carries 2 harpoons, slow + MR shred), R = The Equalizer (flame wall, damage + slow, 130/105/80).
audit.corrected: Correct the slots, state the two harpoon charges, give the Equalizer's 130s rank-1 cooldown, and state the Overheat lockout as the engage window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Every 'track Scrap Shield' line was vague and pointed at the wrong spell.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around Flamespitter 10s, two Electro Harpoon charges, and The Equalizer at 130s.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Rumble's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: The Equalizer zones the wave on a 130s rank-1 cooldown — cross its line, then Cyclone him. Don't dive through the flames.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Scrap Shield's cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver plus Mercury's is your spike — force the fight when his heat bar is full and he Overheats.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Rumble carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Rumble is immobile and squishy, so Cyclone's double knockup plus a Warrior Trickster decoy ends him before he re-heats.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rumble Flamespitter: 10s at rank 1 — step out, then re-enter as it drops. - Electro Harpoon: 2 charges, so expect two slows. - The Equalizer: 130s at rank 1 — his zone is gone until then.

edits.before: Track Rumble's Scrap Shield before you commit
edits.after: Track Flamespitter's cooldown before you commit

edits.before: Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Step out of the cone; his Q is 10s at rank 1 — re-enter then.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Walk out sideways, never along it — the flames slow you the whole way.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: The cone burns for 3 seconds and ramps in Danger Zone — take your hits and leave, or let Warrior Trickster eat the tail.

edits.before: Track Rumble's Scrap Shield: Bait it, then commit. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Scrap Shield is 6s — not the window. Flamespitter's 10s is. Step out, then E-Q-R him.

edits.before: Rumble bullies here: Flamespitter (Q) melts you in minions and Scrap Shield (E) plus Electro-Harpoon slow kite your Nimbus Strike. In the Danger Zone his damage doubles, so don't walk into his heat window.
edits.after: Rumble bullies here: Flamespitter (Q) melts you in minions and Scrap Shield (W) plus two Electro Harpoon (E) charges kite your Nimbus Strike. In Danger Zone his damage climbs, so step in as his Q drops off.

edits.before: The Equalizer (R) zones you off waves and punishes any dive; an even trade favours his ranged DPS. Save Cyclone (R) to gap-close through the ult line, not into it.
edits.after: The Equalizer (R) is 130s at rank 1: it zones you off waves and punishes dives. Cross the flame line rather than fighting in it, and save Cyclone for his commit.

edits.before: Rumble controls 3-6. Danger Zone Flamespitter doubles his damage, Scrap Shield and Electro-Harpoon slow kite your dash, and level 6 Equalizer zones you off the wave. Only engage when his heat bar is low.
edits.after: Rumble controls 3-6. Danger Zone Flamespitter doubles his damage, Scrap Shield and Electro-Harpoon slow kite your dash, and level 6 Equalizer zones you off the wave. Engage while he Overheats and cannot cast.

edits.before: W in when his Flamespitter heat is low
edits.after: Engage while he Overheats and cannot cast

notes: Rumble's kit file flags Scrap Shield (W) with 'knockup' and 'terrain'. Riot's own description is shield + burst of move speed only — tooltip-parse misfire, so I ignored both flags per the brief's rule. Level chart rows 4/5/6 disagreed with the packet chart AND with the matchup's own whys[]; flipped as one atomic pair-set. Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity interactions were not asserted (needsResearch empty = unknown).
